sub_service: Garbage collection complaint via Jodhpur Municipal Corporation's Commissioner contact
description: Jodhpur Municipal Corporation (JMC) handles waste and sanitation complaints through the Commissioner's office, per Rajasthan's Local Self Government (LSG) portal's ULB-Jodhpur citizen charter, which names a real Commissioner as the nodal officer with a direct phone number and email. No service table, SLA, or category-specific routing is published for waste and sanitation. The Jodhpur Development Authority (JDA) is a separate body responsible for urban planning and land/building permissions, not routine civic complaints like this.
procedure: Contact the Commissioner's office by phone or email; the source page offers no category-specific routing beyond this single general contact.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for waste & sanitation complaints specifically -- the contact is real and confirmed, but no published numeric response/resolution time exists on any reachable Jodhpur Municipal Corporation page for any category.
contact_information: Commissioner Hari Singh Rathore: 0291-2651464. Email: mcjodh.lsg@rajasthan.gov.in.
escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE on this page.
